source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and restrained colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One right-facing hedgehog beside one fallen maple leaf; no labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, mushrooms, flowers, extra animals, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock a low hedgehog bean, face wedge, three visible feet, spine boundary, one fallen leaf, and shadow before texture or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one low body bean, one face wedge, three foot ticks, one spine-boundary arc, one leaf envelope with a stem route, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One low body bean with a pointed face wedge and curved spine boundary
anchor_map.becomes: One right-facing hedgehog with a rounded spiny back and small pointed muzzle
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The muzzle points right, the back peaks over the rear half, and the belly stays on the same low baseline in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale bean, wedge, and boundary only in Panel 1; the outer silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly three foot ticks under the body
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly three short visible feet attached beneath the same belly, with the far rear foot hidden by the side-view body
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: One rear foot and two forward feet touch the shared baseline; none float or swap position.
anchor_map.construction_note: Ticks only until the three visible feet are wrapped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One five-lobed leaf envelope with a short stem route at lower right
anchor_map.becomes: One fallen muted-orange maple leaf beside the hedgehog nose
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The leaf stays outside the animal silhouette, its stem points toward the nose, and the closest lobe never covers the front foot.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale envelope and stem only until Panel 4.

final_elements.name: hedgehog leaf foot and shadow construction guides
final_elements.description: One body bean, face wedge, spine arc, three foot ticks, one five-lobed leaf envelope with stem, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: low right-facing hedgehog silhouette
final_elements.description: One rounded spiny back, small pointed muzzle, low belly, and short rear curve.

final_elements.name: three visible feet one ear eye and nose
final_elements.description: Exactly three short visible feet on the baseline, one rounded ear, one bright eye, and one dark nose; the far rear foot remains hidden in the side view.

final_elements.name: five-lobed fallen leaf and face boundary
final_elements.description: One maple leaf with exactly five broad lobes and a short stem plus one clean boundary between the soft face and spiny coat.

final_elements.name: grouped spines leaf veins and broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: Grouped backward-pointing spine clusters, five main leaf veins, two small face hatches, and one broken shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained hedgehog and leaf color map
final_elements.description: Directional graphite, warm-brown spines, pale-tan face, muted-orange leaf, dark nose and eye, and cool-gray shadow.

final_elements.name: spine depth leaf accents and paper highlights
final_elements.description: Small established spine shadows, leaf-edge accents, foot contact darks, and open-paper highlights.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: three visible feet one ear eye and nose
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The belly keeper line stops at the three reserved visible foot contacts so no finished belly line is erased when the feet are added.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen mapped graphite and restrained color, and clarify the same hedgehog, three visible feet, spines, leaf, highlights, and shadow.
allowed_changes: small established spine leaf and highlight clarification

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a drifting body bean or leaf, or a hedgehog that changes pose, scale, facing direction, foot position, or nose angle.
Reject missing or extra feet, ears, eyes, noses, leaves, leaf lobes, or a leaf that overlaps a foot after being placed outside the body.
Reject a final that introduces spines, colors, mushrooms, flowers, extra leaves, extra animals, lettering, or props absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy poster rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
